rules.description: Challenge filtered show listings (crawlers walking filter combinations)
rules.expression: (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/shows/year/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) in {"/shows/stats" "/shows/stats/"}) and http.request.uri.query ne "" and not ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".data") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "utm_") and not cf.client.bot
